classic_fixes.config.title: Classic Fixes
classic_fixes.config.ghastSwell.tooltip: The ghast inflates before spitting its fireball, like up to 1.2.5.
classic_fixes.config.minecartPush.toolti: A moving minecart (or one you stand in) pushes you, like in 1.2.5.
classic_fixes.config.minecartSync.toolti: In singleplayer the minecart syncs every tick and turns instantly.
classic_fixes.config.instantTeleport.too: Endermen and other teleporting entities snap to their target instead of sliding.
classic_fixes.config.creativeKit.tooltip: Entering creative (singleplayer) fills the hotbar with the 1.2.5 blocks.
classic_fixes.config.notchApple.tooltip: A player named Notch drops an apple on death.
classic_fixes.config.golemParticles.tool: Snowflakes or snowballs when building a snow or iron golem.
The player marker on maps updates every tick instead of 4 times per second.
classic_fixes.config.randomDamageTilt.to: Sourceless damage (fall, fire, hunger...) tilts the camera to a random side.
classic_fixes.config.loadingTitles.toolt: "Entering the Nether", "Respawning"... on the loading screen.
classic_fixes.config.sidewaysBackwardWal: Walking backwards turns the body sideways, like before 1.12.
classic_fixes.config.classicHeadTurn.too: The head turns up to 75 degrees from the body and the body settles about 60 degrees to the side when walking backwards, like 1.2.5 to 1.11 (now 50).
classic_fixes.config.twistedArm.tooltip: The empty first-person hand is twisted after the player model was drawn riding.
classic_fixes.config.fallTilt.tooltip: View and hand tilt when falling or jumping, like 1.12.2. Needs view bobbing.
classic_fixes.config.voidParticles.toolt: Grey specks near the bottom of the world, like in 1.7 (without the fog).
classic_fixes.config.betaLighting.toolti: Grayscale: the resource pack's darker Beta lighting. Colorized: modern lighting with warm torches and blue nights. Changes instantly; F7 toggles it in game (change the key in Controls).
classic_fixes.config.oldSmoothLighting.t: Corners next to solid blocks get darker like b1.7.3; glass and leaves don't shade. Works with Sodium. Reloads resources when changed.
classic_fixes.config.oldArmSwing.tooltip: The swing lasts 8 ticks (now 6), every click restarts it, and the hand no longer dips from the 1.9 attack cooldown.
classic_fixes.config.noArmSway.tooltip: The first-person hand stays fixed to the camera instead of lagging behind, like b1.7.3.
classic_fixes.config.betaFog.tooltip: Distance fog starts at a quarter of the render distance like b1.7.3 (from the player in the Nether). Water, lava and blindness fog are unchanged. Works with Sodium.
